segments.ja132:1.1: Kusalūpadese dhitiyā daḷhāya ca, anivattitattābhayabhīrutāya [avatthitattābhayabhīrutāya (sī. syā. pī.)] ca;
segments.ja132:1.3: Na rakkhasīnaṃ vasamāgamimhase, sa sotthibhāvo mahatā bhayena meti.
segments.ja132:2.1: Bhīruka [pañcagaruka (sī. pī.), pañcabhīruka (syā.), abhayabhīruta §(?)] jātakaṃ dutiyaṃ.
